lines.text: Every sound in Auracle is a real modular patch: oscillators, filters, envelopes and effects, wired together.
PATCH shows the whole circuit. Every knob sits at its true position, in musical units: hertz, seconds, decibels.
Green cables carry the sound. A knob that something is modulating pulses with it.
Turn any knob and you hear it at once.
Every knob is an address in the patch's genome, so an edit becomes part of what the search works from. Lock a knob, and evolution leaves it alone.
The node bank holds all forty-two modules. Hover one to read what it does, then drag it into the patch.
Steps is a sequencer for timbre: eight values that walk any knob through a pattern, in time with the tempo.
When PERFORM is turning knobs, PATCH shows it. An amber pointer marks the value you're hearing, and hovering names the control that's turning it.
And EVOLVE keeps the lineage: what every generation changed, in plain words.
The whole instrument, all the way down. Nothing is hidden.
